name: Exp_ColorZeroLAG_MA
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZeroLAG_MA indicator, which is a zero-lag moving average composed of two smoothing layers. It opens buy positions when the zero-lag MA turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable buy/sell enable switches and separate close-on-reverse logic. Position sizing uses multiple money management modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorZeroLAG_MA零滞后均线指标进行交易，当均线向上拐头时开多单，向下拐头时开空单。支持独立配置买入/卖出的开仓和平仓开关，并提供多种资金管理模式包括固定手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于ColorZeroLAG_MA零滞后均线的方向变化进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（均线下行）且Value[0]>Value[1]（最新值反转向上）时开多单，同时平空单；当Value[1]>Value[2]（均线上行）且Value[0]<Value[1]（最新值反转向下）时开空单，同时平多单。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓，以及固定的止损和止盈参数。仓位管理支持四种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按可用保证金减浮亏比例、按余额减浮亏比例，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode选择计算方式。策略使用了两个平滑层的零滞后均线，第一层默认SMA周期12，第二层默认JJMA周期5，通过双层平滑减少滞后性来更早捕捉趋势转折。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on directional changes of the ColorZeroLAG_MA zero-lag moving average. Entry conditions: when Value[1]<Value[2] (MA declining) and Value[0]>Value[1] (latest value reversing upward), a buy position is opened and sell positions are closed; when Value[1]>Value[2] (MA rising) and Value[0]<Value[1] (latest value reversing downward), a sell position is opened and buy positions are closed. Exit conditions rely on reverse signal triggers for closing, along with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters. Position sizing supports four modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, and percentage of balance minus floating loss, plus a fixed lot mode. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for calculation method. The strategy employs a dual-layer zero-lag moving average with a default first layer of SMA period 12 and second layer of JJMA period 5, reducing lag through double smoothing to capture trend reversals earlier.

pros: 采用零滞后均线双层平滑设计，相比传统单层均线能更早捕捉趋势转折点，减少信号滞后
提供多种资金管理模式和灵活的买卖开平仓开关，适应不同风险偏好和交易需求
使用新K线检测机制（IsNewBar）避免同一根K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈参数可配置，提供了基础的风险控制框架
支持多种价格类型和10种平滑算法，策略参数灵活可调
pros_en: Dual-layer zero-lag moving average design captures trend reversals earlier than traditional single-layer MAs, reducing signal lag
Multiple money management modes and flexible buy/sell open/close switches accommodate different risk preferences and trading needs
New bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) prevents repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Configurable StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
Supports multiple price types and 10 smoothing algorithms, offering flexible strategy parameter tuning
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值过大，在大多数品种上可能相当于没有有效止损，风险极高
缺乏点差过滤和波动率过滤，在市场波动剧烈或点差较大时可能产生虚假信号导致不利成交
没有持仓数量检查和重复开仓防护，可能在同一方向上多次开仓导致过度暴露
策略仅依赖单一指标的拐头信号，缺乏多重确认机制，在震荡市中容易频繁反复开平仓造成亏损
SignalBar默认为1但允许设为0导致每tick都重新计算信号，可能在实时报价时产生不稳定信号
cons_en: Default StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments, effectively providing no meaningful stop, posing extreme risk
Lacks spread filter and volatility filter, which may generate false signals and result in unfavorable fills during high volatility or wide spread conditions
No position count check or duplicate position prevention, potentially opening multiple positions in the same direction leading to overexposure
Strategy relies solely on a single indicator's turning signal without multi-confirmation, prone to frequent whipsaw trades in ranging markets
SignalBar defaults to 1 but allows setting to 0, causing signal recalculation on every tick which may produce unstable signals on live quotes
improvements: 增加点差过滤和ATR波动率过滤，避免在点差过大或市场剧烈波动时开仓，减少虚假信号和滑点损失
增加持仓数量限制和同向重复开仓检查，防止过度暴露风险
将止损止盈改为基于ATR动态计算，替代固定点数，使风险控制更适应不同市场波动环境
增加趋势强度确认（如ADX或成交量过滤），减少震荡市中的频繁假突破交易
增加移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，在趋势行情中保护已有利润
improvements_en: Add spread filter and ATR volatility filter to avoid opening positions during wide spreads or extreme market volatility, reducing false signals and slippage losses
Add position count limits and same-direction duplicate position checks to prevent overexposure risk
Replace fixed-pip StopLoss/TakeProfit with ATR-based dynamic calculation for better risk adaptation across different market volatility environments
Add trend strength confirmation (e.g., ADX or volume filter) to reduce frequent false breakout trades in ranging markets
Add trailing stop functionality to protect profits during trending moves

risk_points: 默认止损1000点过大，在多数品种上可能无法提供有效的下行保护
缺乏持仓数量检查，可能在同方向上重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
SignalBar=0时每tick都会重新计算信号并可能触发交易，缺乏稳定的信号确认机制
没有点差过滤，高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
risk_points_en: Default StopLoss of 1000 points is too large to provide effective downside protection on most instruments
No position count check may lead to repeated same-direction entries causing excessive risk exposure
When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated every tick potentially triggering unstable trades without proper confirmation
No spread filter may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
